reading.title: Bioluminescence in Deep Sea Creatures
reading.passage: Bioluminescence is the production of light by living organisms through chemical reactions. Many deep-sea creatures possess this remarkable ability to survive in complete darkness. For instance, anglerfish use a glowing lure to attract prey, while jellyfish emit light for communication and defense. Scientists believe that approximately 90% of deep-sea creatures produce bioluminescence. This adaptation provides significant evolutionary advantages in the ocean's depths where sunlight cannot penetrate.

questions.q: What is the primary function of bioluminescence in anglerfish?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'anglerfish use a glowing lure to attract prey'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 정답은 C번입니다.

questions.q: According to the passage, what percentage of deep-sea creatures produce bioluminescence?
questions.explanation: 'approximately 90% of deep-sea creatures produce bioluminescence'라는 문장에서 답을 찾을 수 있습니다. 정답은 C번입니다.

questions.q: Why can't sunlight reach deep-sea organisms?
options: B) Because the ocean is too deep
D) The passage does not explain this
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'complete darkness'와 'where sunlight cannot penetrate'라고 언급하지만, 구체적인 이유는 설명하지 않습니다. 정답은 D번입니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work is more productive than working in a traditional office environment'?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현 (agree/disagree)과 2-3개의 핵심 이유를 미리 제시하는 thesis statement 작성
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유 설명: 원격근무의 장점 (예: 집중력 향상, 출퇴근 시간 절약) 또는 사무실 근무의 장점 (예: 팀 협업, 감독) 중 선택하여 구체적 사례와 함께 설명
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유 설명: 첫 번째와 다른 관점에서 입장 지지. 예를 들어, 원격근무 선호 시 업무-생활 균형 언급 또는 사무실 근무 선호 시 회사 문화 강조
structure.conclusion: 도입부의 thesis를 다시 언급하며 강력하게 마무리. 향후 전망이나 일반화된 진술로 결론짓기

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer learning through online courses. Others prefer attending classes in person. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer... because...
One reason is that... and this helps me to...
Another advantage of... is that it allows me to...
Personally, I find that... is more beneficial for me.
To summarize, I believe... is the better option because...
sample_points: 온라인 학습의 유연성: 자신의 일정에 맞춰 학습 가능하며, 어려운 부분을 반복 학습할 수 있는 장점
대면 학습의 상호작용: 교수와 학생 간 즉각적인 피드백, 동료 학생들과의 협력 학습, 직접적인 질문 가능의 이점

listening.title: Campus Library Renovation Project
listening.script: Student: Hi, I heard the library is being renovated. When will it reopen? Librarian: Yes, we're excited about the project. The main renovation will take about three months, so we expect to reopen by September 1st. Student: Three months? What improvements are you making? Librarian: We're adding more study spaces, installing new computer labs, and creating quiet zones for focused reading. We're also expanding our digital resources collection. Student: That sounds great. Will we have access to the books during the renovation? Librarian: Unfortunately, no physical access for now. However, we've moved the most popular books to a temporary location in the student center. You can request items online and pick them up there. Student: Okay, that's helpful. Is the temporary location open the same hours as the main library? Librarian: Actually, it's open one hour longer in the evenings to accommodate more students during the renovation period.

questions.q: When does the librarian expect the library to reopen?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'we expect to reopen by September 1st'라고 명확히 말했습니다. 정답은 C번입니다.

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned as an improvement during the renovation?
questions.explanation: 대화에서 study spaces, computer labs, quiet zones, digital resources 확충이 언급되었지만, 새로운 카페테리아(cafeteria)는 언급되지 않았습니다. 정답은 C번입니다.

questions.q: How can students access books during the renovation?
options: A) Request online and pick up at student center
B) Use the main library with limited hours
D) Wait until September to access any books
questions.explanation: 사서가 'You can request items online and pick them up there'라고 설명했습니다. 여기서 'there'는 student center를 의미합니다. 정답은 A번입니다.
